info.title: tables-administration
info.description: Manage data the way you need it.

get.summary: [api v2] List the format packs Tables ships

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: Packs returned, with how much of each is installed and whether it has newer rules

400.description: A shipped pack cannot be read

401.description: Current user is not logged in

403.description: Logged in account must be an admin

get.summary: [api v2] Preview importing a format pack

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the pack, such as nl

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: What the import would do to each format of the pack

400.description: No such pack, or it cannot be read

401.description: Current user is not logged in

403.description: Logged in account must be an admin

post.description:
Formats that would change an installed one need a choice. Without it the import answers 409 with those formats; the next request carries resolution[{technicalName}]=keep or replace for each of them.
This endpoint requires admin access

resolution.description: keep or replace, by technical name

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the pack, such as nl

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

409.description: Formats would change and have no resolution

400.description: No such pack, it cannot be read, or a resolution is not keep or replace

401.description: Current user is not logged in

403.description: Logged in account must be an admin

delete.description:
Removes exactly the formats installed from the pack. Columns that use them keep their values and are reported as broken; when there are such columns, the request has to confirm how many.
This endpoint requires admin access

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the pack, such as nl

parameters.name: confirmBrokenColumns
parameters.description: Number of columns that will break, as the 409 response gave it

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

409.description: Columns use the formats and their number was not confirmed

401.description: Current user is not logged in

403.description: Logged in account must be an admin

technicalName.description: Name a column subtype refers to; lowercase letters, digits and underscores, not the name of a built-in subtype

type.description: Column type the format applies to, text or number

rule.description: JSON Logic rule a value has to satisfy, read as {"var": "value"}

example.description: Value that satisfies the rule, shown in validation errors

enabled.description: Whether columns can use the format

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

401.description: Current user is not logged in

403.description: Logged in account must be an admin

put.description:
The technical name and type cannot be changed, so columns keep referring to the same format.
This endpoint requires admin access

rule.description: JSON Logic rule a value has to satisfy

example.description: Value that satisfies the rule; an empty string removes it

enabled.description: Whether columns can use the format

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

401.description: Current user is not logged in

403.description: Logged in account must be an admin

delete.description:
Columns that use it keep their values and are reported as broken. When columns use the format, the request has to confirm how many: without that number it answers 409 with it. Formats shipped with Tables cannot be deleted, only disabled.
This endpoint requires admin access

parameters.name: confirmBrokenColumns
parameters.description: Number of columns that will break, as the 409 response gave it

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

409.description: Columns use the format and their number was not confirmed

401.description: Current user is not logged in

403.description: Logged in account must be an admin

post.summary: [api v2] Preview a change to a format
post.description:
Shows how many columns use the format and how many of their stored values would fail the changed definition, without storing it. Stored values stay readable after the change, but writes of failing values are refused.
This endpoint requires admin access

tags.name: table_schema
tags.description: Tables as JSON Schema 2020-12, for clients and tools that describe objects that way.

tags.name: format_pack
tags.description: The format packs Tables ships, such as the formats of a country. Only administrators can see, install and remove them.

tags.name: format
tags.description: Formats that text and number columns can name as their subtype. Everyone can read the enabled ones; only administrators can see disabled formats and create, change or delete formats.
